title: Lifting a decoded configuration
statement: Let $\Gamma$ and $Q$ be types, let $\Gamma$ have decidable equality, and let $e : \{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\} \hookrightarrow \Gamma$ be an injection. For every finite input word $x$ over $\Gamma$ and every configuration $D$ with $k$ work tapes on input $x$, lifting the configuration obtained by decoding $D$'s work-tape symbols, using an all-false Boolean input of the same length, and then lifting its symbols via $e$ recovers $D$ exactly.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from Boolean values into $\Gamma$
A configuration $D$ with $k$ work tapes on an input word $x$ over $\Gamma$
